correctness.rationale: Cumulant expansion and variance normalization yield the stated analytic Phi. Its derivative has the exact negative polynomial. Factorial coefficient domination proves p=0 origin sharpness for every t>0. Taylor lower sums e^2>7 and e^10>22000 yield strict witness p=1/10000, t=2. Uniform negative derivative, compact maximizer cutoff, and continuity force a positive coexistence parameter. Checks in check.py reproduce every arithmetic inequality; no finite sample is used as a replacement for the infinite proof.
